title: Supported perfect gluing using relative restriction functors
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $W,V\subseteq X$ opens, $T\subseteq X$ any subset, and $Y=W\cup V$. Choose derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category] with common Hom universe $w$ on $X,W,V,W\cap V,Y$ and all localized open sites of $W,V,Y$. Let $A\in D(\mathcal O_W)$ and $B\in D(\mathcal O_V)$ be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], with every cohomology stalk vanishing off $T$ in the respective opens. Let $L,J_W,J_V$ be direct restriction from $X$ to $Y,W,V$, and $P_W,P_V,S_W,S_V$ transported restrictions from $Y$ to $W,V$ and from $W,V$ to $W\cap V$. Use canonical comparisons $k_W:L\mathbin{\ggg}P_W\cong J_W$, $k_V:L\mathbin{\ggg}P_V\cong J_V$, $s_W:J_W\mathbin{\ggg}S_W\cong J_{W\cap V}$ and $s_V:J_V\mathbin{\ggg}S_V\cong J_{W\cap V}$ [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Given $c:S_W(A)\cong S_V(B)$, $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $a:A\to J_W(E)$ and $b:B\to J_V(E)$ satisfying $(s_W)_E\circ S_W(a)=(s_V)_E\circ S_V(b)\circ c$, there exist a perfect $F\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ with vanishing cohomology stalks on $Y\setminus T$, a map $\alpha:F\to L(E)$, and isomorphisms $i_W:P_W(F)\cong A$, $i_V:P_V(F)\cong B$ satisfying $(k_W)_E\circ P_W(\alpha)=a\circ i_W$ and $(k_V)_E\circ P_V(\alpha)=b\circ i_V$. No affineness, quasi-compactness, or stabilization is assumed.

source.place: Two-open gluing paragraph, Tag 08DG; local perfectness Tag 08CM

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-relative-open-gluing to A, B, c, E, a, b and the given compatibility equation. Obtain F, alpha, iW and iV and both map equations, without any assertion of perfectness or support.

Compare each relative exact restriction with restriction along the open immersion X.homOfLE using Modules.overMapCompOverEquiv and the counit of Modules.overEquiv. Derive this natural isomorphism and compose it with iW or iV. At a point x of Y, choose W or V containing its ambient point. Choose a strictly perfect model of the corresponding A or B. Take the image of its neighbourhood under the open immersion into Y and its canonical isoImage. Compose overEquiv, restriction along isoImage.inv and inverse overEquiv to transport the model termwise. The equivalence preserves zero objects, finite coproducts of the unit module and the retract equations, hence strict perfectness. The restriction composition and localization comparisons identify its derived object with F restricted to that neighbourhood. This supplies exactly IsPerfect Y F. The private local_perfect_of_open_immersion proves this construction in Lean.

For each degree and point of Y outside T, again choose W or V containing the point. Apply homology and then the stalk functor to the corresponding local isomorphism. Compose with mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso and Modules.restrictStalkNatIso to identify this local homology stalk with that of F at x. Transport Subsingleton along the resulting additive equivalence from hAT or hBT. This is the private stalk_subsingleton_of_open_immersion, and yields the required support statement. Combine perfectness, support, the same local isomorphisms and the two map equations. The pointwise argument includes empty cover members and the empty union.

proof_origin.place: A3: underlying gluing separated; perfectness by Definition 08CM and termwise model transport; support by exact homology/stalk comparisons, all local steps proved in Lean

theorem exists_supported_relative_open_gluing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens) (T : Set X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ O : W.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over O))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ O : V.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over O))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ O : (W ⊔ V).toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace).over O))]
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory W.toScheme) (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme)
    (hA : IsPerfect W.toScheme A) (hB : IsPerfect V.toScheme B)
    (hAT : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : W.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj A).val.presheaf x)))
    (hBT : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : V.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj B).val.presheaf x))) :
    let L := (schemeOpenRestriction X (W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let JW := (schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory
    let JV := (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory
    let PW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let PV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let SW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)).mapDerivedCategory
    let SV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let kW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)
    let kV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)
    let sW := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)
    let sV := schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso X (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    ∀ (c : SW.obj A ≅ SV.obj B) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (a : A ⟶ JW.obj E) (b : B ⟶ JV.obj E),
      SW.map a ≫ sW.hom.app E = c.hom ≫ SV.map b ≫ sV.hom.app E →
      ∃ (F : schemeDerivedCategory (W ⊔ V).toScheme) (α : F ⟶ L.obj E),
        IsPerfect (W ⊔ V).toScheme F ∧
        (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : (W ⊔ V).toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
          Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj F).val.presheaf
              x))) ∧
        ∃ (iW : PW.obj F ≅ A) (iV : PV.obj F ≅ B),
          PW.map α ≫ kW.hom.app E = iW.hom ≫ a ∧
          PV.map α ≫ kV.hom.app E = iV.hom ≫ b
